doc.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08

chapter: Eureka Brass Band and Sonny Henry
title: Old band music, bass parts and artificial notes
summary: They discuss Red's old music, tough bass parts, and using artificial notes on trombone and valve instruments.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: That peg horn in that baritone is missing. Yeah. Because they got some of that, we got some of that old music up there now if Red was to go through it. Show you that old music we used to play. I was showing Sonny a piece there at what you call it? Chicago? Tribune. Chicago Tribune. Chicago Tribune. Yeah. Chicago Tribune. Right over there. We got all that there. Red's got a lot of old music that we used to use up there. See? Yeah I saw some of that. All good music too.
He's right over there because at base we got to work and then he's no doggone well. If he come here with me I'm gonna be on him with this bass part because he's no rock that bass.

The bass part started tough on some of those things. Yeah. Tough. You see those bass parts there. Some of these fellas not fast enough with these fingers. See them fingers. They got their fingers too stiff on it. Fingers got to be super. Just same as theirs on the trumpet.

No it's heavy. You can't press down on anything like that. No it's heavy. Yeah. You got your finger got to be super. Now the other man can handle one of those. He can handle the bass. Now listen you see. But I'm gonna put him on the bass you see.

See now. See the irony of this. With your bass. You got to know the artificial thing. You understand. So if something comes difficult to you. You must know how to make one thing work. So you see if something comes difficult to you, you must know how to make one thing one way. You must know how to steer and do everything. You must take advantage of your instrument. Never let your instrument take advantage of you. You must always try to take advantage of your instrument. And so that's where I feel at all times. The thing that I see is easy to make, that's the way I make it.
The same way with the trombone, you see, this thing that you can make on the trombone, you can make an artificial note. Make an artificial note, you see, on the trombone.
Use that third valve sometimes and catch funny things, you know.
No, no, no. You're right. The third valve. And sometimes that first and third valve, it gets a lot of things too.

Yeah, but if you don't know it, how are you going to do it? If you don't know it, you can't make it, there you are. You just got to be guessing. That's all. Because even while you're guessing, the band's gone. That's right.
